summary: Validated the 3 new FR->PT client-side redirects added in App.js (/devis->/orcamentos, /factures->/faturas, /entreprise->/empresa) plus the 10 previously validated redirects, and verified the public /_redirects file (served 200, contains all 13 rules). Admin login (admin@construpilot.io) works and grants access to Pro routes so the target pages (QuoteTracking, Invoices, Entreprise) render after redirect. All redirect URLs resolve correctly with no 404s.

issues: Page still renders significant French copy (Tout ConstruPilot en un coup d'oeil, Estimateur de travaux, Chiffrage instantane, Ver les tarifs mixed with PT). Out of scope of this task but worth flagging to E1 for i18n consistency.

critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 292 lines and imports 60+ page components at top level; consider React.lazy for heavy Pro-only routes to reduce initial bundle.
The /_redirects file duplicates the client-side <Navigate> rules; kept intentionally for SEO 301 signal — acceptable, but ensure both stay in sync when new aliases are added.
Features page (/funcionalidades) still contains French copy; unrelated to redirects but user-facing inconsistency for the PT audience.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 13 client-side redirects verified via headless browser navigation on public URL. /_redirects file also reachable (200, 811 bytes, 13 rules). Note: /inscription in a logged-in session redirects to /compte because Login component sends authenticated users to /compte — expected. In an anonymous session it would go to /registo.
rca of the issue: N/A - no issues found in tested scope
